contexts.text: How they who dwell diametrically opposite stand on their feet...
Self-love is diametrically opposite to the celestial things of love.
This number of the circumference does not indeed answer geometrically to the diameter...
These two loves... are diametrically opposite to each other.
Wherefore Hell is under Heaven, diametrically opposite to it; that is, diametrically opposite like two men lying in opposite ways...
The universals of Hell are diametrically opposite to the universals of Heaven...
Evil itself is diametrically contrary to the Lord.
Hereditary evil is diametrically opposite to the Lord of Heaven.
They love the places there which are diametrically underneath.
